claims.text: On DEBRIEFED with Chris Ramsay, 21 August 2026, at 3:21:29, Richard Doty said he knew of autopsies on recovered bodies 'from people like Kate Green and others that work for the Institute for Armed Force Institute for Pathology', then corrected himself within the same passage from 'green did autopsies' to 'he saw the aftermaths read reports'. No document opened here names any individual at the Institute.

claims.text: On DEBRIEFED with Chris Ramsay, 21 August 2026, at 1:17:09, Richard Doty said that Jaime Shandera 'was an asset that was being used by the Naval Investigative Service, which is now Naval Criminal Investigative Service.
